QuestInfo.name: A Gift for Akai
QuestInfo.1: Princess Suzume says the Gigatoad's lingering magic on Hamadaya must be dispelled. Deliver the medicine she gave you to Akai.
QuestInfo.2: Princess Suzume says the Gigatoad's lingering magic on Hamadaya must be dispelled. Deliver the medicine she gave you to Akai.\nAkai is touched when you bring her the medicine.

0.0: If you're on your way back to town, can you do me one last favor? For Akai?

yes.0: While the Gigatoad is gone, his vile magic still lingers. The ninja still crawl through the castle, but Nobuo and Fuji and Fujihawk can take care of them. No, it's #p2200000# I'm worried about. Can you deliver this medicine to Akai so she can give it to her father?

no.0: I command you to change your mind.

1.0: You weren't useless, after all! You rid the castle of the Gigatoad and saved the princess and the Daimyo. Not bad for a day's work. \r\n#L0##bAnd I'm about to save your father, too. Here, give him this medicine. Princess Suzume says it'll turn your father back to normal.#l\n#k
1.1: Well! This is unexpected. I suppose I should thank you.

yes.0: My father and I won't forget what you've done for us. Now get out of here before you make me cry.

npc.0: While the Gigatoad is gone, his vile magic still lingers. The ninja still crawl through the castle, but Nobuo and Fuji and Fujihawk can take care of them. No, it's #p2200000# I'm worried about. Can you deliver this medicine to Akai so she can give it to her father?

item.0: So! The Gigatoad's gone. But how come my father's still acting so weird?
